notes: QA-2 locked verification: all four carry-forward findings are fixed or closed as stated. There are no regressions in the files I read. I read code with Read and Grep only and did not run `git rev-parse HEAD` or any tests, so the HEAD check on 64c0e85 and the new tests are not confirmed by me.

RBP-F003 is closed as stated. `read_repo_bytes` and `read_repo_text` in `sc-jev-check/src/extract/read.rs` (lines 38-59) now take `&RepoRelativePath`, and `validate_relative` is gone. The subjects extractor handles the '-' sentinel first and then converts through `repo_path` (`extract/subjects.rs:49-54`). The `InputSpec` and `CheckSpec` String paths are recorded as deferred to r-2 and r-3c in `sprint-r-1-types-break.md` line 794, with the reason. That line is labelled 'half applied by design'. One wording item: the plan text at `sprint-r-1-types-break.md:469` still says 'the one validator for repo-relative paths'. That is plan text, not rustdoc, so it does not block.

RBP-F201 is fixed. `JudgeOutcome::check_against(&PayloadBundle)` shares `check_answers` with `new` (`judge.rs:232-254`). `StoredSession::from_document` calls it for every stored outcome and maps a failure to a session-document error (`session/mod.rs:651-655`). The type doc now says plainly that `Deserialize` cannot check against the payload. `tampered_stored_outcome_is_session_document_invalid` exists at `session/tests.rs:175`.

RBP-F202 is fixed. `PayloadBundle` now has `as_str()` and `into_text()` (`payload.rs:217,223`). Session `open` uses `bundle.as_str()` (`session/mod.rs:212`). The LLM backend `prepare` uses `request.payload().as_str()` (`backend.rs:160`). `sc-jev-py` uses `into_text()` (`run.rs:110,130`). `utf8_payload`, its fake error branches and the `expect` are gone.

RBP-F104 is closed. The triage additions are recorded at `sprint-r-1-types-break.md:799-802`: `SubjectsSource`, `SubjectsProducer` and `ChoiceAnswer` are frozen wire types, and `LlmWireContext` keeps one public field. `ExtractInput` is no longer `#[non_exhaustive]`; its fields stay public, as the coordinator claimed. I did not re-read the sprint doc to confirm the triage rationale text beyond those lines.

I did not check the 'from your notes' fixes (`Rev` Deserialize via parse, `SessionId` FromStr, `BackendKeyId::as_str` exhaustive, the Mock Behaviour enum, `EqualInputRecord::new` returning Result). I also did not check the r-2 deferrals for `JudgeOutcome::new(&PayloadBundle)`, `BackendSet` adoption, criteria re-derivation, `BackendCapabilities` and the `unwrap_or`. Those are minor items from the first round, outside the locked finding set, and I made no judgement on them.
